headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Jameson Taillon pitching 4.0 innings and striking out 3 batters. The New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves 8-5, led by Brett Baty's home run and 4 RBIs. In another close game, the Minnesota Twins defeated the Baltimore Orioles 5-9, with Josh Bell contributing 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. The New York Yankees placed right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow neuritis. The Toronto Blue Jays also placed Jameson Taillon on the 15-day injured list with right forearm tendinits. Other teams have made roster moves due to injuries, including the Cincinnati Reds, Miami Marlins, San Francisco Giants, Colorado Rockies, Texas Rangers, and Los Angeles Angels.

The Kansas City Royals made a significant trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 2-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow victory over the Boston Red Sox, winning 2-1. Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 innings for the Blue Jays, striking out 3 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in 5-9 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-9 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Yankees RHP Kervin Castro Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow neuritis, effective retroactive to August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being dealt from the Miami Marlins.
